firstWorkout.name: First Rep
firstWorkout.celebrate: The first stroke in the ø. Everything else builds on it.

workouts10.name: Double Digits
workouts10.celebrate: Ten times you set out. That is no whim any more.

workouts50.name: Regular
workouts50.celebrate: Fifty sessions. The barbell knows you by name.

workouts100.name: Centurion
workouts100.celebrate: A hundred times you showed up. Nobody takes that from you.

firstPr.name: New Best
firstPr.desc: Beat your estimated max from an earlier week on any exercise.
firstPr.celebrate: Stronger than last week. That is what progress looks like.

volume10t.name: Ten Tonnes
volume10t.celebrate: Ten tonnes moved. That is about two elephants.

allRounder.name: All-Rounder
allRounder.desc: Do one strength and one cardio or sport session in the same week.
allRounder.celebrate: Strength and endurance in one week. Variety suits you.

firstMeal.name: First Bite
firstMeal.celebrate: The first meal is in. From here your day has a face.

threeMeals.name: Three Meals
threeMeals.desc: Log breakfast, lunch and dinner on one day.
threeMeals.celebrate: All three main meals in view. A whole day.

meals100.name: A Hundred Plates
meals100.celebrate: A hundred meals noted. You know your plate.

meals500.name: Five Hundred
meals500.celebrate: Five hundred times you looked. That is knowledge about yourself.

wellFuelled.name: Well Fuelled
wellFuelled.desc: On a training day with at least three entries, land between 90 and 115 % of your level.
wellFuelled.celebrate: Training and plate in tune. That is how you get stronger, not just tired.

proteinWeek.name: Protein Week
proteinWeek.desc: Close the protein ring for a week.
proteinWeek.celebrate: A full week of enough protein. Your muscles say thanks.

proteinStreak4.name: Four Protein Weeks
proteinStreak4.desc: Close the protein ring four weeks in a row.
proteinStreak4.celebrate: Four weeks of protein reliability. That is a foundation.

bridgeDay.name: The Bridge
bridgeDay.desc: Log at least 25 g of protein within three hours after a session.
bridgeDay.celebrate: Training, then plate. The exact link møni was made for.

rhythm4.name: Four in Rhythm
rhythm4.desc: Keep your rhythm for four weeks in a row.
rhythm4.celebrate: Four weeks in a row. Chance turned into habit.

rhythm12.name: A Quarter
rhythm12.desc: Keep your rhythm for twelve weeks in a row.
rhythm12.celebrate: Twelve weeks in rhythm. A whole quarter of reliability.

rhythm26.name: Half a Year
rhythm26.desc: Keep your rhythm for 26 weeks in a row.
rhythm26.celebrate: Half a year. You are not just along for the ride, you are in it.

fullWeek.name: Full Week
fullWeek.desc: Close all rings in one week.
fullWeek.celebrate: Food, training, protein: all in one week. Round.

fullWeek4.name: Four Full Weeks
fullWeek4.desc: Close all rings in four weeks.
fullWeek4.celebrate: Four round weeks. The ø is complete.

comeback.name: Back in Rhythm
comeback.desc: Complete a week in rhythm after at least two weeks without.
comeback.celebrate: You are back. That counts for more than any streak.

goodPause.name: Good Pause
goodPause.desc: Return within three days after a pause of five days or more.
goodPause.celebrate: Took a break, came back. That is how rhythm works.

weekendKeeper.name: Weekend Keeper
weekendKeeper.desc: Keep both Saturday and Sunday for four weekends in a row.
weekendKeeper.celebrate: Four weekends in rhythm. That is the hardest stretch.

fullMonth.name: Whole Month
fullMonth.desc: Keep your rhythm in every week of a calendar month.
fullMonth.celebrate: A whole month in rhythm. Your month pattern is closed.

firstWeigh.name: First Weigh-in
firstWeigh.celebrate: The starting point is set. What counts now is the course, not the day.

trendReady.name: Trend Unlocked
trendReady.celebrate: Enough data points for a real trend. From now on møni calculates with you.

adaptiveOn.name: Your Body Talks
adaptiveOn.desc: møni adjusts your level to your real burn for the first time.
adaptiveOn.celebrate: møni has adjusted your level to your real burn.

bodyGoal2kg.name: Two Kilos Closer
bodyGoal2kg.desc: Your trend weight is 2 kg closer to your goal.
bodyGoal2kg.celebrate: Two kilos in the right direction. Calm and steady.

strongAsYou.name: Bodyweight Lift
strongAsYou.desc: Reach an estimated max of at least your body weight on a basic lift.
strongAsYou.celebrate: You move your own body weight. Respect.

goalReached.name: Arrived
goalReached.desc: Your trend weight is within 0.3 kg of your goal weight.
goalReached.celebrate: You are there. Time to breathe and plan what comes next.

firstPhoto.name: First Snap
firstPhoto.celebrate: Photo taken, plate recognised. It is always this quick now.

firstVoice.name: Talkative
firstVoice.celebrate: Talking instead of typing. Handy, isn’t it?

firstLabel.name: Fine Print
firstLabel.desc: Scan a nutrition label by photo.
firstLabel.celebrate: You read labels. Not many do.

scanner25.name: Scanner
scanner25.celebrate: Twenty-five scans. You are faster than the checkout.

firstFavorite.name: First Regular
firstFavorite.celebrate: Your first regular is saved. Next time it takes one tap.

ownExercise.name: Own Move
ownExercise.celebrate: An exercise that exists only for you.

healthLinked.name: Connected
healthLinked.desc: Connect Apple Health and import a session from it.
healthLinked.celebrate: Your training from Health has arrived in your day.

patternFound.name: Pattern Found
patternFound.desc: Unlock the first pattern hint in Insights.
patternFound.celebrate: Enough days for a pattern. møni sees how food and training work together.

reviews4.name: Review Reader
reviews4.desc: View four weekly reviews to the end.
reviews4.celebrate: Four times you looked back. Reflecting keeps you going.

sharedFirst.name: Passed It On
sharedFirst.celebrate: You shared something nice. Thank you.

oneYear.name: One Year
oneYear.desc: Use møni for a year and keep at least 8 days in the last 30.
oneYear.celebrate: A year. Your ø has a history.

shelf.title: Stamps
shelf.empty: Your first stamps arrive on their own.

plusTen.name: Plus Ten
plusTen.desc: Raise the estimated max of an exercise by 10 % from where you started.
plusTen.celebrate: Ten percent more than at the start. That is real work.

firstRhythm.name: First Rhythm
firstRhythm.desc: Complete your first week in rhythm.
firstRhythm.celebrate: The first week in rhythm. It begins.
